0.1: I therefore propose an exchange, a TRADE, if you will. Surely we can conduct such business in a civilized, amenable manner?

yes.0: Good luck then, my funny foreign friend. I shall amuse myself with some light reading or a meditation on economic fundamentals. And forget not my need for #b40 of the precious #t4033579##k items, hmm? Seek your fortune among the #r#o2400105##k creatures of the #b#m401030200##k.
